item.title: Six Years as Sole IT Administrator: Building and Maintaining Infrastructure for a Growing Startup
item.description: As the sole in-house IT administrator at Praedicat, I was fully responsible for managing and maintaining the company’s IT infrastructure across multiple locations. My role combined hands-on technical support with long-term infrastructure planning, ensuring system reliability, security, and scalability for a growing organization.
